g.text: The shared scorer: a dot product between question and candidate
• cosine similarity between 'what is asked' and 'this candidate', scaled by 10, plus a learned bias b
• the same head scores time intervals and text options; only the output rule differs:
pᵢ = σ(sᵢ): is this interval inside the event?
pᵢ = softmax(s)ᵢ: which option is right?
Projections start from small random weights (std 0.005), biases at zero. Why drop the final MLP? Pre-MLP features are
known to carry semantic similarity (FreeRet); the ablation slide shows no loss.
